Calls ConditionalInit(&unk_8AFE18) to initialize state tracking on global unk_8AFE18.
Calls ConditionalStateReset(&unk_8AFE18) to reset state tracking on global unk_8AFE18.
Calls sub_542200(0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0) to restore the full unit viewport rectangle.
Calls CameraProjectionUpdate(14) to update the camera projection matrix.
Writes the rectangle bounds to the output pointers: *a2 = v6, *a3 = v5, *a4 = v8, *a5 = v7.
